analysis.analysis: R-046: Testable behavior includes verifying presence of troubleshooting content for sign-on failures. Boundaries involve valid/invalid sign-on states. Ambiguity: Exact wording of troubleshooting text. R-047: Testable behavior is presence of buddy list visibility troubleshooting. Boundary: empty vs populated buddy lists. R-048: Testable behavior is forward/back navigation accuracy. Normal path: navigate pages sequentially; abnormal path: navigating past history limits. R-049: Testable behavior is minimize, maximize, and close button functionality on the toolbar. Normal path: clicking buttons alters window state. R-050: Testable behavior is page up/down key responses. Normal path: scroll view by one page. R-051: Testable behavior is hiding and reopening the toolbar. Normal path: toggle visibility state. R-052: Testable behavior is up/down arrow key scrolling. Normal path: scroll view incrementally. R-053: Testable behavior is drag-and-drop restriction. Abnormal path: dragging files into help window must be blocked. R-054: Testable behavior is clicking non-clickable areas. Normal path: zero UI state change or navigation. R-055 to R-062: Testable behavior is correct display and printing of specified help categories (Help Contents, Web Help, Mail/News, IM, Customizing, Privacy, Creating Web Pages, What's New). Normal path: render and print match source formatting. R-063 to R-068: Testable behavior is correct display of specific help topics (Security, Same Time, Streamlined Interface, Standards, New to Net, Technical Support). Normal path: render without errors. R-069 to R-071: Testable behavior is correct rendering of International Users, Feedback Center, and About pages. Normal path: load page content successfully. R-072: Testable behavior is shortcut button activation for all Help drop-down selections. Normal path: use shortcuts to trigger respective menu items.
